<div class="monitor-page-subtitle">
Monitor the availability of selected ERDDAP datasets by category and status.
</div>

```{python}
import html
import pandas as pd
from IPython.display import HTML, display

# -----------------------------
# Load watchlist CSV
# -----------------------------
watch = pd.read_csv("spreadsheets/erddap-dataset-monitoring.csv")
watch.columns = watch.columns.str.strip()

if "dataset_ID" in watch.columns:
    watch = watch.rename(columns={"dataset_ID": "datasetID"})

for col in ["datasetID", "label", "category"]:
    if col not in watch.columns:
        watch[col] = ""

watch["datasetID"] = watch["datasetID"].fillna("").astype(str).str.strip()
watch["label"] = watch["label"].fillna("").astype(str).str.strip()
watch["category"] = watch["category"].fillna("").astype(str).str.strip()

watch.loc[watch["label"] == "", "label"] = watch["datasetID"]
watch.loc[watch["category"] == "", "category"] = "Other"

# -----------------------------
# Load ERDDAP out-of-date table
# -----------------------------
url = "https://coastwatch.pfeg.noaa.gov/erddap/outOfDateDatasets.csv"
status = pd.read_csv(url)
status.columns = status.columns.str.strip()
status["datasetID"] = status["datasetID"].fillna("").astype(str).str.strip()

# -----------------------------
# Merge watchlist with ERDDAP status
# -----------------------------
df = watch.merge(status, on="datasetID", how="left")

# -----------------------------
# Status classification
# -----------------------------
def classify_status(value):
    try:
        value = float(value)
    except Exception:
        return "Not Flagged"

    if value < 1:
        return "OK"
    elif value < 2:
        return "Delayed"
    else:
        return "Outdated"


def row_css_class(status_value):
    return {
        "OK": "ok",
        "Delayed": "warning",
        "Outdated": "stale",
        "Not Flagged": "not-flagged",
    }.get(status_value, "not-flagged")


def badge_css_class(status_value):
    return {
        "OK": "status-ok",
        "Delayed": "status-warning",
        "Outdated": "status-stale",
        "Not Flagged": "status-not-flagged",
    }.get(status_value, "status-not-flagged")


status_order = {
    "Outdated": 1,
    "Delayed": 2,
    "OK": 3,
    "Not Flagged": 4,
}

df["status"] = df["outOfDate"].apply(classify_status)
df["status_sort"] = df["status"].map(status_order).fillna(99).astype(int)
df["row_class"] = df["status"].apply(row_css_class)
df["badge_class"] = df["status"].apply(badge_css_class)

df["outOfDate_display"] = df["outOfDate"].apply(
    lambda x: "Not listed" if pd.isna(x) else f"{float(x):.2f}"
)
df["maxTime_display"] = df["maxTime"].fillna("Not listed")

df = df.sort_values(
    ["status_sort", "category", "label"],
    ascending=[True, True, True]
).reset_index(drop=True)

# -----------------------------
# Counts for summary chips
# -----------------------------
ok_count = int((df["status"] == "OK").sum())
warning_count = int((df["status"] == "Delayed").sum())
stale_count = int((df["status"] == "Outdated").sum())
neutral_count = int((df["status"] == "Not Flagged").sum())

# -----------------------------
# Build row HTML
# -----------------------------
rows = []

for _, row in df.iterrows():
    label = html.escape(str(row["label"]))
    dataset_id = html.escape(str(row["datasetID"]))
    category = html.escape(str(row["category"]))
    status_txt = html.escape(str(row["status"]))
    out_of_date = html.escape(str(row["outOfDate_display"]))
    max_time = html.escape(str(row["maxTime_display"]))
    row_class = html.escape(str(row["row_class"]))
    badge_class = html.escape(str(row["badge_class"]))
    status_sort_value = int(row["status_sort"])

    erddap_info_url = f"https://coastwatch.pfeg.noaa.gov/erddap/info/{dataset_id}/index.html"

    rows.append(f"""
    <div class="dataset-row {row_class}"
         data-category="{category}"
         data-status="{status_txt}"
         data-status-sort="{status_sort_value}">
      <div class="dataset-left">
        <div class="dataset-title">
          <a href="{erddap_info_url}" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">{label}</a>
        </div>
        <div class="dataset-id">
          <strong>Dataset ID:</strong> <span>{dataset_id}</span>
        </div>

        <div class="dataset-meta">
          <span><strong>Out-of-date score:</strong> {out_of_date}</span>
          <span><strong>Latest available data:</strong> {max_time}</span>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="dataset-right">
        <div class="dataset-category">{category}</div>
        <div class="status-badge {badge_class}">{status_txt}</div>
      </div>
    </div>
    """)

html_out = f"""
<div class="monitor-filter-shell">

  <div class="monitor-status-label">Dataset Update Status:</div>

  <div class="monitor-chip-row">
    <div class="monitor-chip monitor-chip-stale">Outdated: {stale_count}</div>
    <div class="monitor-chip monitor-chip-warning">Delayed: {warning_count}</div>
    <div class="monitor-chip monitor-chip-ok">OK: {ok_count}</div>
    <div class="monitor-chip monitor-chip-neutral">Not Flagged: {neutral_count}</div>
  </div>

  <div class="monitor-filterbar">
    <div class="monitor-filterbar-left">
      <div class="monitor-filter-group">
        <label for="categoryFilter">Satellite Data Product</label>
        <select id="categoryFilter">
          <option value="all">All</option>
        </select>
      </div>

      <div class="monitor-filter-group">
        <label for="statusFilter">Status</label>
        <select id="statusFilter">
          <option value="all">All</option>
        </select>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="monitor-filterbar-right">
      <div class="monitor-summary" id="monitorSummary">Loading datasets...</div>

      <div class="monitor-help-inline">
        <strong>Out-of-date score:</strong>
        <span class="help-ok">&lt;1 OK</span>
        <span class="help-sep">·</span>
        <span class="help-warning">1–2 Delayed</span>
        <span class="help-sep">·</span>
        <span class="help-stale">≥2 Outdated</span>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="dataset-section">
  <div id="datasetGrid" class="dataset-table">
    {''.join(rows)}
  </div>
</div>

<div id="emptyState" class="empty-state" style="display:none;">
  No datasets match the current filters.
</div>

<script>
(function() {{
  const grid = document.getElementById("datasetGrid");
  const rows = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll(".dataset-row"));
  const categoryFilter = document.getElementById("categoryFilter");
  const statusFilter = document.getElementById("statusFilter");
  const summary = document.getElementById("monitorSummary");
  const emptyState = document.getElementById("emptyState");

  const categories = [...new Set(rows.map(row => row.dataset.category))].sort();
  const statuses = ["Outdated", "Delayed", "OK", "Not Flagged"];

  for (const cat of categories) {{
    const option = document.createElement("option");
    option.value = cat;
    option.textContent = cat;
    categoryFilter.appendChild(option);
  }}

  for (const stat of statuses) {{
    if (rows.some(row => row.dataset.status === stat)) {{
      const option = document.createElement("option");
      option.value = stat;
      option.textContent = stat;
      statusFilter.appendChild(option);
    }}
  }}

  function sortVisibleRows() {{
    const visibleRows = rows.filter(row => row.style.display !== "none");

    visibleRows.sort((a, b) => {{
      const aStatus = Number(a.dataset.statusSort);
      const bStatus = Number(b.dataset.statusSort);

      if (aStatus !== bStatus) return aStatus - bStatus;

      const aCategory = a.dataset.category.localeCompare(b.dataset.category);
      if (aCategory !== 0) return aCategory;

      const aTitle = a.querySelector(".dataset-title").textContent;
      const bTitle = b.querySelector(".dataset-title").textContent;
      return aTitle.localeCompare(bTitle);
    }});

    visibleRows.forEach(row => grid.appendChild(row));
  }}

  function updateView() {{
    const selectedCategory = categoryFilter.value;
    const selectedStatus = statusFilter.value;
    let visible = 0;

    rows.forEach(row => {{
      const categoryMatch =
        selectedCategory === "all" || row.dataset.category === selectedCategory;
      const statusMatch =
        selectedStatus === "all" || row.dataset.status === selectedStatus;

      const show = categoryMatch && statusMatch;
      row.style.display = show ? "" : "none";

      if (show) visible += 1;
    }});

    sortVisibleRows();

    summary.textContent = `${{visible}} dataset${{visible === 1 ? "" : "s"}} shown`;
    emptyState.style.display = visible === 0 ? "" : "none";
  }}

  categoryFilter.addEventListener("change", updateView);
  statusFilter.addEventListener("change", updateView);

  updateView();
}})();
</script>
"""

display(HTML(html_out))
```
